events.title: 피터 실턴 , at 42 the oldest player in the Football League, departs from 더비 카운티 after nearly five years to become player-manager of 플리머스 아가일. 버밍엄 시티 chairman Samesh Kumar vows to impose life bans on anyone convicted of taking part in the pitch invasion against 스토크 시티.
Welsh international midfielder Joey Jones , who plays for 렉섬 at club level and turned out for 리버풀 earlier in his career, announces his retirement as a player on his 37th birthday.

노팅엄 포리스트's hopes of a cup double are ended as they are beaten 1–0 by 포츠머스 at Fratton Park in the FA Cup sixth round. In the league, Leeds go top of the First Division with a 3–1 win over 토트넘 홋스퍼 at White Hart Lane , which sends the hosts down to 17th place. Luton climb out of the relegation zone with a 1–1 draw at home to 크리스털 팰리스. QPR beat 맨체스터 시티 4–0 at Loftus Road . 윔블던's resurgence continues with a 2–0 home win over 노츠 카운티, who fall into the relegation zone. In the Second Division, 블랙번 로버스 suffer a shock 3–0 away defeat to 브리스틀 로버스, allowing 입스위치 타운 to draw level on points with them by beating 왓퍼드 1–0 at Vicarage Road. Oxford climb out of the Second Division relegation zone with a dramatic 5–3 win over local rivals 스윈던 타운 at the Manor Ground .
리버풀's bid for a fifth FA Cup triumph remains on track as they beat 애스턴 빌라 1–0 at Anfield.
Caretaker manager Joe Kinnear is placed in charge of 윔블던 on a permanent basis.

선덜랜드 hold 첼시 to a 1–1 draw at Stamford Bridge in the FA Cup sixth round. In the top-flight, 아스널 beat Oldham 2–1 while Steve Cherry is Notts' hero at home to Villa: the County custodian saves 스티브 스톤턴 's penalty kick in a goalless draw that sees the Nottingham club pull out of the bottom three. In Second Division action, league leaders 블랙번 로버스 draw 2–2 with play-off hopefuls 사우스엔드 유나이티드, while 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 win away at high-flying 케임브리지 유나이티드.

퀸스 파크 레인저스 inflict another 4–1 defeat on a title-chasing side, this time 리즈 유나이티드 at Loftus Road . 더비 카운티 spend £1.3million on 레스터 시티 striker Paul Kitson , while 맨체스터 시티 sign Dutch defender Michel Vonk from HVV for £500,000.
더비 카운티 spend another £1.3million on another striker – Tommy Johnson from 노츠 카운티 – while 아스널 sell 20-year-old striker Andy Cole to 브리스틀 시티 for £500,000 after a loan spell.

Lee Chapman scores his second hat-trick in just months as Leeds win 5–1 at home to 윔블던, with 에리크 캉토나 scoring twice to keep the leaders on top. 맨체스터 유나이티드 beat 셰필드 유나이티드 2–1 at Bramall Lane, but are two points behind the leaders and have three games in hand. Luton keep out of the drop zone by holding 에버턴 to a 1–1 draw at Goodison Park. Oldham head closer to securing a place in the new Premier League with a 4–3 home win over 노츠 카운티, who remain in the drop zone when a victory would have lifted them out of it. 셰필드 웬즈데이 keep their faint title hopes alive with a 2–0 away win over 토트넘 홋스퍼, who now occupy a dismal 18th place in the league and are just five points clear of the relegation zone. 웨스트햄 유나이티드 remain bottom after losing 2–0 at home to 아스널. 블랙번 로버스 remain top of the Second Division with a 3–0 win over Brighton at the Goldstone Ground, while 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 take a big step towards survival with a 3–1 home win over second-placed 입스위치 타운. 케임브리지 유나이티드 keep their automatic promotions hopes alive with a 2–1 win over 브리스틀 시티 at Ashton Gate . 포츠머스 keep on track for a playoff place with a 6–1 home win over 밀월.
The only league action of the day sees 사우샘프턴 climb out the drop zone by beating 맨체스터 시티 1–0 at Maine Road , with Iain Dowie scoring the only goal of the game.

The FA Cup quarter-final replays see 노리치 시티 beat 사우샘프턴 2–1 and 선덜랜드 beat 첼시 2–1. 브루스 리옥 resigns after two years as 밀월 manager to be replaced in the manager's seat by 35-year-old defender 믹 매카시 . In the Fourth Division, bottom club 올더숏 are wound up in the High Court with debts in excess of £1million, but are given seven days to appeal against the verdict and have been allowed to continue in the Football League. 리버풀's UEFA Cup run ends in a 4–0 aggregate semi-final defeat by 제노아 of Italy, who beat them 2–0 in both legs.
더비 카운티 break their transfer record again by signing 노츠 카운티 striker Tommy Johnson for £1.3million after a loan spell.

첼시 player 비니 존스 sets a Football League record by receiving a yellow card after only three seconds of the game against 셰필드 유나이티드 . The game ends in a 2–1 win for the Blades at Stamford Bridge. 토트넘 홋스퍼 are now 19th in the First Division after a 2–1 defeat to 리버풀 at Anfield, although they are four points clear of 20th-placed Luton and have three games in hand. The bottom three of Luton, 노츠 카운티 and 웨스트햄 유나이티드 all drop points. Darren Beckford scores a hat-trick for 노리치 시티 in a 4–3 win over 에버턴 at Carrow Road . 블랙번 로버스 remain top of the Second Division despite a 2–0 home defeat at home to 찰턴 애슬레틱, who climb three places to fifth. 미들즈브러's promotion hopes are boosted by a 4–0 home win over Brighton, who are still in the relegation zone.
In the only league action of the day, leaders Leeds draw 1–1 with 아스널 at Highbury. They currently have a two-point lead over 맨체스터 유나이티드, but their nearest rivals still have two games in hand.
케니 달글리시 takes his 블랙번 로버스 spending to £5million in five months with a £750,000 move for 스윈던 타운 striker Duncan Shearer .

올더숏 go out of business and are forced to resign from the Football League. Their resignation disrupts the League's plans to expand to 94 clubs for the following season, and it is announced that rather than promoting a second club from the Football Conference (or relegating the bottom-placed Fourth Division club to restore the League to 92 members), the following two seasons will proceed with a 93-club Football League, with further discussions on league reconstruction to take place for the 1994–95 season. 올더숏's resignation seemingly condemns 동커스터 로버스 to the humiliation of finishing in bottom place, as they are now nine points adrift of second-bottom 칼라일 유나이티드.
Clive Allen's three-month spell at 첼시 ends with a £275,000 move to relegation-threatened 웨스트햄 유나이티드.

Leeds drop two vital points when they are a held to a goalless draw by bottom club 웨스트햄 유나이티드 at Elland Road, but 맨체스터 유나이티드 also drop points when they are held to a goalless draw at QPR. Gordon Durie scores a hat-trick for 토트넘 홋스퍼 in their 4–3 home win over Coventry. 웨스트햄 유나이티드 are now eight points adrift of safety with nine games left to play. 노츠 카운티's survival hopes suffer a major blow with a 3–2 home defeat to 크리스털 팰리스. 블랙번 로버스 surrender their lead of the Second Division with a 2–1 defeat at 반즐리, with 입스위치 타운 going top as they beat 더비 카운티 2–1.

뉴캐슬 유나이티드's Second Division survival bid is given a major boost when they beat local rivals 선덜랜드 1–0 at home. In the last-ever Full Members Cup final, 노팅엄 포리스트 beat 사우샘프턴 3-2 after extra time at Wembley, but lose defender 스튜어트 피어스 for the rest of the season with a knee injury.

The month ends with 맨체스터 유나이티드 still top of the league, now one point ahead of 리즈 유나이티드 and with a game in hand after two 폴 인스 goals help them beat 노리치 시티 3–1 at Carrow Road . 루턴 타운 and 웨스트햄 유나이티드 remain in the relegation zone, and have been joined by 노츠 카운티. Four successive wins in March have seen 사우샘프턴 move five points clear of danger. 입스위치 타운 have displaced 블랙번 로버스 at the top of the Second Division, with the play-off zone occupied by 케임브리지 유나이티드, 미들즈브러, 레스터 시티 and 찰턴 애슬레틱. 리버풀 maintain fourth place in the First Division with a 4–0 home win over 노츠 카운티, who are now six points adrift of safety and having play more games than all the other teams in the bottom seven.
